metadata.breaking_event: Breaking Event Scanner 23:02 UTC: 2 NEW events — Netanyahu rejects Gaza peace plan + Houthi Aramco strike; Gold $4,343 + 77% Fed hike probability. 4 escalated: Ebola 4,000+ cases doubling every 10 days, PBOC restarting liquidity injections, Europe fiscal stress with RBA hiking, Argentina risk at 451. All 12 domains active. Risk score 520.

fin_stability.name: Financial Stability
fin_stability.note: BREAKING: US-Japan-Korea trilateral FX intervention. Treasury volatility surging. Gold at $4,343 (record territory). German Bund yield above 3.10%. Bond market stress across all developed markets. Fed futures pricing 77% rate hike for September. 3 FOMC dissenters. BofA warns Fed strategy could weigh on economy. US sold $638B T-bills this week.

liquidity.name: Liquidity Conditions
liquidity.note: FIMA repo facility used for joint intervention. Dollar funding stress. Treasury 30Y at highest since 2007. BOJ spent 6-8 trillion yen in 2 days. Yen giving up intervention gains at 157.76.

energy.name: Energy Security
energy.note: BREAKING: Strait of Hormuz — Iran-Oman deal close but Iran demanding 6 conditions (lift blockade, sanctions, withdraw troops, pay reparations, release assets, cease attacks). Houthi drone strike on Saudi Aramco refinery on Red Sea coast. Oil pulling back from $92 to $83.59 but supply disruption continues.

gold.name: Gold / Precious Metals
gold.note: RECORD TERRITORY: Gold at $4,343.43 (Aug 7), broke above $4,300. Up 2.44% single day, up 27.79% YoY. Strongest weekly gain since January. Fed 77% hike probability for September. Safe haven demand from Iran war + currency war + JGB crisis + global rate hike cycle.

europe.name: Europe Stability
europe.description: ECB Deposit Rate (proxy for EU stability)
europe.note: German 10-year Bund yield at 3.10%, above 3.0% tripwire. European fiscal stress - periphery spreads widening. ECB forward curve pricing 40bps hikes by end 2026. Spanish debt decoupling from Germany/France. RBA (Australia) raised rates 3x to 4.35% from Iran war energy shock — global rate hike cycle spreading.
